## Validation

## Evaluation integrity

- [ ] Mutation operators do not import, invoke, or derive validity from the Judge under evaluation.
- [ ] Any score or sample result states its corpus, count, and limits.
- [ ] `unknown` has not been silently collapsed into a stronger result.

## Documentation and privacy

- [ ] I updated `README.md` and `README.ja.md` together when the first-use path changed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, raw prompts, transcripts, observations, or private corpus data.
